title: Guidance for Preparing Standard Operating Procedures, EPA QA/G-6
notes: EPA QA/G-6, EPA/600/B-07/001, April 2007. EPA's current Quality Program Directives page states that this version replaces the March 2001 EPA/240/B-01/004 document. Supports SOP purpose, organization-specific detail, repeatability, accessibility, current/superseded version control, records, and quality-system use. It is EPA quality-system guidance, not a cannabis-specific legal requirement.
